name: Queue failed or overdue native Famulor email replies as HubSpot tasks

parameters.jsCode: const c=$input.first().json;const now=new Date();const end=new Date(Date.UTC(now.getUTCFullYear(),now.getUTCMonth(),now.getUTCDate()));const start=new Date(end.getTime()-1*86400000);return [{json:{...c,windowStart:start.toISOString(),windowEnd:end.toISOString(),runAt:now.toISOString()}}];

nodes.name: Select reply failures and overdue threads

parameters.content:
## Native email reply follow-up
Create internal CRM tasks for failed or overdue auto-replies in native Famulor email. Does not watch Gmail/Outlook connector threads, send replies or create CRM contacts. Preview is enabled; empty results do not write.

## Setup
Select a Famulor History-read HTTP Header Auth credential (calls:read). Select HubSpot Service Key credentials with engagement/task creation access. Set pendingMinutes (minimum 5) and maxTasks (1–100). No contact association or real owner is bundled.

## Scan and classification
Reads previous UTC-day activity, validates all pages and selects failed replies or pending replies older than the threshold at run time. Stops before all writes if the task cap is exceeded. Copies references and state only, not message content or raw error text.

## Before enabling writes
Test the exact export in a designated HubSpot test area and review task permissions, ownership and notifications. Tasks are unassociated by default. Re-running the same window can create duplicates. This is a windowed review queue, not a complete historic backlog monitor.
